deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for the best chance (rolling review); the final deadline is January 18, 2027.
deadline.quote: Applicants are encouraged to apply by December 1st for the best chance of admission. | The final deadline for applications is January 18th, 2027.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: Starting Fall 2021, the ESS department does not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test is required.
gre_subject.quote: A GRE subject test is not required.

supervisor.value: A provisional advisor is assigned at admission, but applicants are encouraged to contact prospective advisors.
supervisor.quote: Students will be assigned a provisional advisor at the time of admission. | Students are encouraged to contact prospective faculty advisors about their research interests.

funding.value: All admitted students, including international students, are fully funded through employment and/or fellowships.
funding.quote: all admitted students (including international students) are fully-funded via employment and/or fellowships.

also.quote: Guaranteed funding and full tuition and fee coverage, including health insurance.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 minimum; a Speaking score of 26 is preferred for TA service.
toefl_min.quote: For the TOEFL, a minimum of 80 is required.

ielts_min.value: IELTS overall 7 with no module below 6; Speaking 8 preferred.
ielts_min.quote: For the IELTS, an overall minimum of 7 and no less than 6 on any module is required.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Earth System Science covers atmosphere, ocean, land and climate, so it is filed under environment with earth as a second field. Entry route is not stated.
